notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance and a Rogue as an attacker, triggering Emeritus of Abundance's ability, causing it to become prepared.
Deal combat damage using the Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
